    calculateFinalPrice(Product, double) - Method in interface Business.Customer
    Calculates the final price this customer pays for the given product at the given provider selling price, applying any VAT rules, discounts, or special pricing specific to this customer type.
    calculateFinalPrice(Product, double) - Method in class Business.Entities.CorporateClient
    Calculates the final price for a corporate client by applying the VAT multiplier directly to the provider's base selling price — bypassing the product's own Product.calculatePrice(double) so that product-specific VAT rates do not compound with the corporate VAT rule.
